description: This file handles radio temperature statistics collection, processing, and event notification for Wi-Fi radios. It includes functions for argument validation, key generation, data processing, API execution, and cache copying related to radio temperature sensors.

methods.name: int validate_radio_temperature_args(wifi_mon_stats_args_t * args)
methods.description: Validates the input arguments for radio temperature statistics functions, ensuring the radio index is within bounds.

methods.name: int generate_radio_temperature_clctr_stats_key(wifi_mon_stats_args_t * args,char * key_str,size_t key_len)
methods.description: Generates a key string for collector-side radio temperature stats based on the args.

methods.name: int generate_radio_temperature_provider_stats_key(wifi_mon_stats_config_t * config,char * key_str,size_t key_len)
methods.description: Generates a key string for provider-side radio temperature stats based on the config.

methods.name: int process_radio_temperature_stats(wifi_mon_stats_args_t * args,radio_data_t * radio_data,void ** stats,unsigned int * stat_array_size)
methods.description: Allocates memory and copies the radio temperature data, filtering out zero values.

methods.name: int execute_radio_temperature_stats_api(wifi_mon_collector_element_t * c_elem,wifi_monitor_t * mon_data,unsigned long task_interval_ms)
methods.description: Main function to gather radio temperature via HAL, update cache, and send events if subscribed.

methods.name: int copy_radio_temperature_stats_from_cache(wifi_mon_provider_element_t * p_elem,void ** stats,unsigned int * stat_array_size,wifi_monitor_t * mon_cache)
methods.description: Copies cached radio temperature data for a specific radio into a stats structure.
